note: Safety notes shown on goals that match a tag (D-087). Keyword-derived; a reviewer may add or remove tags per goal later.

rules.label: Job and income offers
rules.what_to_know: Real employers and real scholarships do not charge you to apply or to be hired. Check the company and the person before you share documents or bank details.
red_flags: asks you to pay for a form, training or equipment first
interview only on WhatsApp or Telegram
salary far above the usual
a cheque or transfer 'to buy equipment'
urgent deadline
rules.where_to_get_help: Search the company on its official site and on CAC records, then report scams on EFCC's Eagle Eye page

rules.label: Money, investing and payments
rules.what_to_know: Money tools can lose you money. Check that the provider is licensed in your country and read the fees before you send anything. Nothing here is financial advice.
red_flags: promises of fixed or doubled returns
pressure to recruit others
withdrawal fees before you can cash out
app that asks for your contacts and photos
unlicensed lender
rules.where_to_get_help: SEC Nigeria and CBN lists for licensed providers; EFCC for fraud reports

rules.label: Children and teaching
rules.what_to_know: Children's data and images are sensitive. Use child-safe platforms, avoid sharing identifying details and follow your school's rules and the law on children's data.
red_flags: an app that asks for a child's full name, photo or location
open chat with strangers
ads aimed at children
sharing children's work publicly without consent
rules.where_to_get_help: Take It Down for removing images; your school's safeguarding lead; the Nigeria Data Protection Commission

rules.label: Health information
rules.what_to_know: These tools give information, not a diagnosis. For anything serious or urgent, see a qualified health worker or go to the nearest hospital.
red_flags: a tool that diagnoses with certainty
a cure with no side effects
selling prescription drugs without a prescription
rules.where_to_get_help: A licensed doctor or pharmacist; NAFDAC to check a product

rules.label: Contracts, registration and tax
rules.what_to_know: Templates and AI drafts are a starting point. Have a lawyer or the official body confirm anything that binds you or your business, because rules change.
red_flags: an agent who wants cash to 'speed up' registration
a copied contract you do not understand
ignoring a filing deadline
rules.where_to_get_help: The official portal for the agency concerned; a qualified lawyer or accountant

rules.label: Privacy and accounts
rules.what_to_know: Do not upload private documents (IDs, contracts, medical records) to free online tools you do not know. Use two-step sign-in on important accounts.
red_flags: a site that asks for your password or OTP
a link sent by an unknown contact
a free tool that wants broad permissions
rules.where_to_get_help: Your account provider's recovery page; NDPC for your data rights

rules.label: Using AI tools
rules.what_to_know: AI can be wrong or invent facts and sources. Check anything that matters, do not paste private or customer data, and follow your school or employer's rules on AI use.
red_flags: invented references
confident wrong answers
sharing personal data in a prompt
rules.where_to_get_help: The tool's own privacy settings; your school or employer's AI policy

rules.label: Government and exam services
rules.what_to_know: Use the official site or office only. Official fees are published, and agents who ask for extra money may be scammers.
red_flags: someone offers to 'fast-track' for cash
a lookalike website
fees paid to a personal account
rules.where_to_get_help: The official agency website and offices; report extortion to the relevant agency

rules.label: Copyright and posting
rules.what_to_know: Only use music, photos and clips you made or have a licence for, or you can lose reach or income to copyright strikes. Check the licence on free libraries, and get consent before posting anyone's face or voice.
red_flags: 'free' downloads of paid songs or films
cracked editing software that carries malware
posting someone's photo without asking
rules.where_to_get_help: The platform's copyright help page; the licence terms on the source site
